title: Quantum Space -Time with Energy and Unified Field Theory
content: In this paper, We constructed a Space-Time with energy model just considering the velocity of the light C and the Plank constant h and  "1/" a_g (a_g is the strength of gravition (m/s2)) This model will just provide a probability to combine the Gravitation and Electric-Magnetics field under a basic structure of quantum Space -Time with energy. We hope to throw a little bit light on the big picture of uniting the quantum mechanics and General relative theory. In this paper, We also find the symmetry number structure about line-1/2 for Unified Field Theory.
